text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It happened during the Academy's barbecue gathering—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: No good. There's zero signal out here.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! 
Who would have thought we'd get lost during a simple BBQ?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...That is because you wandered off to survey geological strata,
claiming it "might come in handy for something."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, no one's injured!
All that's left is to find a way out of here—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ah! I simply must observe these geological strata!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Haah.
Good grief, I really can't keep up with this.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hah, we're not coordinated at all, huh~.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Well! Guess we'll just wander around this area.
Then somehow we'll—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah... Found it!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I saw it at the entrance to the BBQ venue
and grabbed one~.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: A map of the area around the venue!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It's a bit of extra baggage, but...
checking the course before a race is essential, right?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ! ...Haha!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
That part of you is seriously cool.
For real.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Eh...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Let's get out of here!
So~? How do we get out from—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Wait, where the heck is "here" to begin with?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Our current location is precisely where you are looking.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon!?
Didn't you go off to look at the strata...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In this area, there are trees that grow only at specific altitudes.
Using those as markers, I calculated past crustal movements from the strata.
After that, simply cross-referencing matching locations on the map—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Allows one to roughly pinpoint our current location.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Securing water... shouldn't be an issue either.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
There was spring water just ahead.
...I'm glad I brought along
my coffee kettle.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa whoa, are you serious!
How'd you know it was nearby?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...A voice called out to me, you see.
It said... "Come over here."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rustle rustle rustle!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek! C-Come to think of it,
aren't there... wild boars in this forest—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOAAAAAAAHHHH!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Phew--...
If it's a living creature, it's no big deal.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'll blaze the trail.
You guys just sit tight and follow me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
They're not over here either...
Where on earth could the four of them—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rustle!)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright! We've arrived, you guys.
Man, glad we managed to sort it out~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyaaaa~~!?
E-E-Everyone, why are you coming out of the mountains...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hm? Oh, we got stranded!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: S-Stranded!?!?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Incredible, I'm so glad you're all safe...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Right~?
No cell signal either, we were totally doomed.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: If it weren't for us, that is.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, wanna do something again?
Another leisure trip or tour together!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I-If possible, I'd prefer something safer next time...
...No, but wait... maybe it's a chance to grow...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: More importantly, sugar, give me sugaaaaar~~.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...We should reconsider the members.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!
You guys really never waver, do ya.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted the four of them hard at work
training on the academy's track.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Bring it on! Face me in a match, Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, okay! Then this time I'll
be in charge of the finish line!
choice_data_list: That friendly rivalry is so like them.

text_block_list.text:
—Fufu, what a coincidence.
I was just thinking the exact same thing.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's how they'll weave it together, won't they?
A brand new era of their own.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted two of them
chatting in the academy hallway.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Please understand, Pokke-kun...
Experimentation itself is the ultimate form of leisure!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You invited me for leisure before, didn't you?
—Here, chug this medicine down! Experience the thrill of knowledge!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? No no no!
That's totally not what leisure means!
